name: 70-border-3d-style
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } p { margin: 8px 0; line-height: 1.6; } .groove { margin: 10px; padding: 10px; border: 8px groove #888888; } .ridge { margin: 10px; padding: 10px; border: 8px ridge #888888; } .inset { margin: 10px; padding: 10px; border: 8px inset #888888; } .outset { margin: 10px; padding: 10px; border: 8px outset #888888; }
html:
凹槽边框 groove
凸起边框 ridge
内嵌边框 inset
外凸边框 outset
